finePrint.summary: Lifetime means the life of the Elasticnote product or service, not your lifetime.

quote.text: Where Elasticnote offers a one-time purchase described as Lifetime, Lifetime Access, Lifetime Pro, or similar wording, "lifetime" refers to the lifetime of the relevant Elasticnote product or service.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime licence only lasts while Elasticnote keeps offering that product or service.

quote.text: A Lifetime licence provides access to the features included with that licence for as long as the relevant Elasticnote product or service continues to exist and be offered.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime does not guarantee that current integrations, AI providers, or features will stay available.

quote.text: A Lifetime licence does not guarantee that every integration, AI provider, external service, feature, model, API, or third-party dependency available at the time of purchase will remain available permanently.

finePrint.summary: Pro is advertised as including unlimited notebooks and unlimited files per notebook.

quote.text: Use Elasticnote free for local-first notes and writing, or choose Pro Monthly or Pro Lifetime for Unlimited notebooks, unlimited files per notebook, Premium PDF export, full AI features, BYO storage, Pro Tools and full collaboration features.

finePrint.summary: There is no fixed refund window in the terms; whatever refund period is shown at checkout or on the pricing page applies.

trials.claimQuote: Shop Premium Tools Starting at $9 😍 Save on Lifetime Access
trials.reasoning: The terms define a one-time Lifetime purchase and the pricing page lists Pro Lifetime as a purchasable plan. The product-lifetime definition limits its duration but does not show lifetime access is not offered.

exhibits.quote: "lifetime" refers to the lifetime of the relevant Elasticnote product or service.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows lifetime is tied to product existence, not purchaser lifetime, undermining perpetual access claim.

exhibits.quote: A Lifetime licence provides access to the features included with that licence for as long as the relevant Elasticnote product or service continues to exist and be offered.
exhibits.argument: Quote limits lifetime to while product exists and is offered, allowing vendor to end access.

exhibits.quote: Where Elasticnote offers a one-time purchase described as Lifetime, Lifetime Access, Lifetime Pro, or similar wording, "lifetime" refers to the lifetime of the relevant Elasticnote product or service.
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms explicitly define Lifetime Access as a one-time purchase offering, confirming lifetime access is offered.

exhibits.quote: Use Elasticnote free for local-first notes and writing, or choose Pro Monthly or Pro Lifetime for Unlimited notebooks, unlimited files per notebook, Premium PDF export, full AI features, BYO storage, Pro Tools and full collaboration features.
exhibits.argument: Pricing page lists Pro Lifetime as a purchasable plan, directly supporting the lifetime access claim.

trials.claim: App includes unlimited notes plus collaboration features
trials.claimQuote: Elasticnote is a privacy-first AI note-taking app with unlimited notes, Markdown support, Kanban boards, local storage, workflows, diagrams, and team collaboration features.
trials.reasoning: The pricing page states Pro plans include unlimited notebooks, unlimited files per notebook, and full collaboration features. The general right to change features in future does not contradict that these are currently included.

exhibits.quote: Elasticnote may change, improve, replace, restructure, or discontinue individual features as the product develops.
exhibits.argument: Quote allows vendor to remove features, contradicting promise of unlimited notes plus collaboration features.

exhibits.quote: A Lifetime licence does not guarantee that every integration, AI provider, external service, feature, model, API, or third-party dependency available at the time of purchase will remain available permanently.
exhibits.argument: Quote voids guarantee that collaboration features will remain available permanently.

exhibits.quote: Use Elasticnote free for local-first notes and writing, or choose Pro Monthly or Pro Lifetime for Unlimited notebooks, unlimited files per notebook, Premium PDF export, full AI features, BYO storage, Pro Tools and full collaboration features.
exhibits.argument: Pricing page confirms unlimited notebooks/files and full collaboration features are included with Pro plans.

trials.claimQuote: 30 Days Money Back Guarantee (For Non-Prime Members/Regular Users).
trials.reasoning: No exhibit states a 30-day refund period for regular users. The exhibits only say refund terms on the checkout or payment provider page apply, which neither confirms nor denies the 30-day claim.

exhibits.quote: Any refund period or eligibility stated on the Elasticnote checkout page, pricing page, or payment provider page at the time of purchase forms part of the applicable purchase terms.
exhibits.argument: Quote makes refund dependent on checkout page terms, not an unconditional 30-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: Refund requests may also be subject to the policies of the payment provider used to complete the transaction.
exhibits.argument: Quote subjects refunds to payment provider policies, limiting the claimed 30-day guarantee.

trials.claimQuote: 60 Days Money Back Guarantee (For DealMirror Prime Members Only).
trials.reasoning: No exhibit states a 60-day refund period for Prime members or mentions Prime membership. The exhibits only say checkout and payment provider terms apply, which neither confirms nor denies the claim.

exhibits.quote: Any refund period or eligibility stated on the Elasticnote checkout page, pricing page, or payment provider page at the time of purchase forms part of the applicable purchase terms.
exhibits.argument: Quote makes refund dependent on checkout page terms, not an unconditional 60-day Prime guarantee.

exhibits.quote: Refund requests may also be subject to the policies of the payment provider used to complete the transaction.
exhibits.argument: Quote subjects refunds to payment provider policies, limiting the claimed 60-day guarantee.

trials.claim: Notes can be saved directly to computer with true ownership
trials.claimQuote: Unlike traditional note-taking software, Elasticnote lets you save notes directly to your computer, giving you true ownership of your information.
trials.reasoning: The terms say users retain ownership of their content and that it may remain stored locally on their device or local filesystem. Being responsible for backups does not contradict local saving or ownership.

exhibits.quote: Elasticnote may never receive or have access to data that remains exclusively on your device.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows vendor cannot restore locally saved notes if lost, undermining true ownership security.

exhibits.quote: You are responsible for maintaining appropriate backups of important local data.
exhibits.argument: Quote shifts backup responsibility to user, contradicting secure true ownership claim.

exhibits.quote: You retain ownership of content that you create, upload, import, generate, or store using Elasticnote.
exhibits.argument: Terms confirm user retains ownership of content, supporting true ownership claim.

exhibits.quote: may remain stored locally in your browser, device, local filesystem, or browser-supported storage.
exhibits.argument: Terms state notes may remain stored locally on device/filesystem, supporting save directly to computer.

trials.claim: Notes stored securely on local computer or encrypted cloud
trials.claimQuote: Your notes remain yours, stored securely on your local computer or encrypted cloud storage.
trials.reasoning: No exhibit confirms secure local storage or encrypted cloud storage. The exhibits only discuss third-party storage availability and user backups, which do not prove or disprove encryption or security.

exhibits.quote: Elasticnote does not control third-party storage providers and cannot guarantee that their services will remain continuously available.
exhibits.argument: Quote disclaims guarantee of encrypted cloud storage availability, undermining secure storage claim.

exhibits.quote: You are responsible for maintaining appropriate backups of important information stored through third-party services.
exhibits.argument: Quote makes user responsible for backups, contradicting promise of secure storage.
